summary: The audit checks the research rotations, the required first-year courses, three core courses from the four areas (STATS 101 and STATS 116 included), BIOC 350 and BIOC 360, and 135 graduate units; there is no minimum number of electives. The proposal defenses, journal club, teaching, seminar participation, candidacy, oral exam and dissertation are checked by hand.

hrpB4iKq.why: "Take three full quarter courses. Each course may be selected from any of the following areas: Biochemistry and Biophysics / Quantitative and Computational Techniques / Genetics / Cell Biology". The Quantitative list's text also names "STATS 101 - Data Science 101" and "STATS 116 - Theory of Probability", which its course list omits. "Each quarter course can be replaced by two mini-courses" and "Other courses may be discussed with the Graduate Advisor" are moved in by hand.

replace.name: Core Courses (three from the four areas)

KVium8uz.why: "there is no required minimum number of electives. However, students must reach the university minimum requirement of 135 units." The 135 units are the Bulletin's program minimum, which the audit checks.

utsblr0q.why: "Second year graduate students will enroll in BIOC 350 'Development of Thesis Research' during the Autumn quarter ... Second year graduate students will defend their proposals before their Thesis Committee by the end of Winter quarter."

children.name: Defend the 1st proposal before the thesis committee by the end of Winter of year 2

nJWy5HGS.why: "Third year graduate students will enroll in BIOC 360 ... Students will provide: A 1-page Specific Aims ... A roughly 10 minute presentation to the department". A student who petitions out of BIOC 360 marks that course met.

children.name: Specific Aims and presentation of the 2nd proposal to the department

wBMGBJm2.why: "Every 4-6 weeks, one 4th year student and one faculty member will present ... Each student will present on a topic outside their thesis research to the Biochemistry Department."

E9ccmLx8.why: "Students are expected to complete department qualifying procedures and apply for candidacy by the summer quarter of their second year in the PhD program." The form's "at least 3 units of course work taken with each of four Stanford faculty members" depends on instructors, which the audit does not know.

QiJF5cpy.why: "At the oral examination, a student will first present to an open audience a seminar on the thesis ... Then, the examining committee meets in private with the candidate"

gctQJEPO.why: "Students must complete a draft of the PhD thesis that is acceptable to the reading committee ... Students must submit their finalized thesis following their oral examination."

add.why: "Teaching experience is an integral part of the PhD curriculum and is required for the degree."
"All PhD students must participate actively in the department's seminar program."

node.name: Active participation in the department's seminar program
